subject: general
question: What is the primary goal of the 5S concept?

options.text: To eliminate the need for maintenance
To increase the number of safety regulations
To improve workplace organisation and efficiency

solution:
The correct answer is __To improve workplace organisation and efficiency**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 5S__ is a workplace organisation method that uses a list of five Japanese words: Seiri, Seiton, Seiso, Seiketsu, and Shitsuke.
 
• These words translate to Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, and Sustain in English.
 
• 5S is aimed at improving efficiency and productivity through systematic organisation.
 
• It helps reduce waste and ensures optimal use of resources.
 
• The method fosters cleanliness, discipline, and standardisation within the workplace.
 
• 5S is widely used in industries to enhance safety, employee morale, and quality control.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sort (Seiri):**
 
 
• Remove unnecessary items from the workplace.
 
• Focus on decluttering and identifying essentials.
 
 
 
• **Set in Order (Seiton):**
 
 
• Arrange items for easy access and efficient workflow.
 
• Ensure tools and materials are stored systematically.
 
 
 
• **Shine (Seiso):**
 
 
• Clean the workplace to ensure hygiene and safety.
 
• Identify and address potential hazards.
 
 
 
• **Standardize (Seiketsu):**
 
 
• Create consistent procedures and guidelines for efficiency.
 
• Maintain standards for organisation and cleanliness.
 
 
 
• **Sustain (Shitsuke):**
 
 
• Develop habits and discipline to maintain 5S practices.
 
• Encourage continuous improvement within the workplace.
